# Group x06 summary: unified-data-plane, source-authority, cross-source-competency, data-platform-vocabulary

## 1. Verdict and tier counts
Graded 233 IDs: 168 unified-data-plane (UDP), 22 source-authority (SRC-AUTH), 43 cross-source-competency (XSRC). data-platform-vocabulary has no open rows: all 43 rows are VERIFIED and its vocab is loaded in production (`schema_sources.rs:1047`).
| spec | READY | THIN | OWNER | DUP | DECISION | EXISTS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| UDP (168) | 24 | 109 | 18 | 6 | 7 | 4 |
| SRC-AUTH (22) | 1 | 12 | 7 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| XSRC (43) | 6 | 30 | 4 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
Tiers: opus 205, sonnet 28 (ADR, deletions, SHACL shapes, rollups). No row is mechanical enough for bind or vllm.

## 2. Cross-spec contracts
All referenced IDs resolve to a defining row except `R094` (SRC-AUTH-R800 "extends R094", no spec defines it). Contracts with a missing side:
| consumer row | provider spec | missing provider row (proposed text) |
|---|---|---|
| UDP-R760.3 incident.* methods | arbora | `ARBORA-OPS-R8xx`: "Arbora serves incident.record_anomaly, correlate, evidence, related_claims and set_status as medulla.incident.* operations." |
| UDP-R761.3 DatasetProfile job | arbora, typed-packs | arbora `profile.*` op; TYPED-PACKS-R803 must cite UDP-R761 (no mention today) |
| UDP-R762.3 QualityEvaluate | arbora | `quality.*` is cited as ARBORA-OPS-R856, but that row sits in hosted-api-operations; fleet-catalog row needed. TYPED-PACKS-R805 cites R762 (one side) |
| UDP-R038.7.7 WebCandidateSet | decision-engine | DE-R802 must name `WebCandidateSet{query_text, query_digest, candidates, retrieved_at}` as its input |
| XSRC-R002.7, R003.4, R003.5 mappings | connectors | `CONN-ERPNEXT`, `CONN-UPTIME-KUMA`, `CONN-CONTAINER-MANAGER` operation-contract rows (no medulla-side reference exists) |
| UDP-R032 Immich pilot | connector immich | `CONN-IMMICH` rows for I0-I6 |
| XSRC-R004.4 resolution | UDP-R030 | R030 lists no thresholds; XSRC and SUPPLY-VOCAB cite R030, R030 does not cite them |
| SRC-AUTH-R007.5, XSRC-R007.2 | arbora | ARBORA-FLEET-R052.3 and R052.2 exist (both sides declared) |
Named both ways and consistent: SRC-AUTH-R001/R002 to XSRC-R001 (vocab names match), UDP-R037 to XSRC-R002.7, FEDERATED-QUERY-R720.2/.3 and DE-R700.7 to XSRC-R009.

## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- Authority shape and vocabulary defined twice: XSRC-R001.1/.2/.4 vs SRC-AUTH-R001/R002/R006. `SourceAuthorityShape` already exists in `virtual_graph-v1.shapes.ttl`. Owner: SRC-AUTH. SRC-AUTH-R009.3 is a spec edit, not behaviour; delete it with XSRC-R001.2.
- Abstention enum: SRC-AUTH-R006 (`CoverageResult::Uncovered` in medulla-rdf) vs XSRC-R006.3. Owner: SRC-AUTH; the report only maps it.
- Conformance runs: UDP-R022 owns them; R019.3.2 and R020.3.2 duplicate it.
- Connection registry: UDP-R612 (all six rows) repeats R002 and R029; R612.1 names types that do not exist and `attached_catalog.rs` has others. Delete the family.
- Document ingest/update/delete (R651) and phase-ordered ingest (R650) overlap MEDULLA-INGEST-WORKER and MEDULLA-REPO-INGEST; neither `medulla-jobs/src/pipeline.rs` nor `medulla-durable/src/document_ops.rs` exists. Owner: ingest-worker.
- Search-index pushdown and replenishment: UDP-R038.5 vs FEDERATED-QUERY-R039/R067. Owner: federated-query.
- Quality (R762) vs TYPED-PACKS-R805; incidents R760 vs R762; catalog search R764 vs retrieval fusion.
- Concept-id allocator: SRC-AUTH-R800 adds `crates/medulla-types/src/concept.rs` while `concept_id.rs` already holds `ConceptId`. Not a source-authority topic; move out.
- Debezium: R021 (VERIFIED) vs R014.2.2 own binlog capture and R018 Debezium bridge; one CDC path only.
- Owner-rule conflicts (one engine, no sync to a second database): UDP-R002.3 and DURABLE-KERNEL-R024 mirror sinks, R023 shared CNPG/MariaDB with replicas, R025 pgrx companion, R033 Postgres replica plus nightly export, R015 WAL-frame tailing, R038 row copy. Recommend: retire mirror sinks, move R023 to services, no-go on pgrx, nightly export only, keep R038 copy only as a watermark-bound cache.

## 4. Hot paths
Served entries that exist: `handle_cypher_read` (`src/server/handlers/query/cypher.rs:61`), `foreign_scan` (`crates/medulla-plan/src/federation_opt/run.rs:26`), `AddNode` stamping (`src/server/handlers/graph_ops/gateway_graph.rs`), `AnalyticsJob` (`src/raft/command/native/catalog.rs`), `EnrichDocument` (`medulla-capabilities/src/domains/ingestion.rs`), CdcHub (`src/server/cdc.rs`). Never reach one: adapters R014-R020 (no attach call site), conformance R022, pilots R026/R032/R033, R650/R651/R700-R702/R710 (target files absent), R760-R764 (bench-only proofs), SRC-AUTH-R800. `select_sources` (medulla-rdf) has no production caller; SRC-AUTH-R010.3 and R004.6 create it. Proving test dirs `tests/federation`, `tests/data_plane`, `tests/federated`, `tests/embedding` do not exist.

## 5. VERIFIED isolation spot check (grep of public items outside own file and tests)
- R021 `debezium_bridge.rs`: `DebeziumChangeEvent`, `DebeziumSource` have no caller in `src/` or other crates. Isolated.
- R024 `platform_admission.rs`: `AdmissionRunner` unused; only `consolidation_isolation.rs` uses `ApplicationAdmission`. Isolated.
- R027 `pg_compat_feature.rs`: `PgCompatFeature` unused. Isolated.
- R029 `schema_context.rs`: `SchemaContextCatalog` and `SchemaContextRequest` unused (no served method). Isolated.
- R003 `attached_catalog.rs`: `AttachedCatalogGraph` unused; `CatalogColumn` used once in `medulla-query/src/sql/catalog.rs`. Mostly isolated.
- R004 `schema_inference.rs`: `ColumnSamplingBudget` unused. Isolated.
- R005 `virtual_graph_mapping.rs`: `VirtualGraphMapping`, `validate_via_operation` unused. Isolated.
- R006 `pushdown_plan.rs`: `PushdownDecision` unused. Isolated.
- SRC-AUTH-R005/R006/R008 (medulla-rdf `source_selection.rs`): `select_sources` has no caller outside medulla-rdf. Isolated.
- SRC-AUTH-R001/R002 vocabulary and shapes: loaded via `schema_sources.rs:1036-1053`. Reached in production.

## 6. Most common gaps
1. No production call site or served proof; bench or crate test only (R760.6, R761.6, R700.6, R750.753).
2. Proving test in a directory that does not exist (R038.3.6, R010.6, R040.6).
3. Generic template rows with no file or values (R612.x, R650.x, R651.x, R701).
4. Live external-system calls placed in the engine instead of a connector (R018.2.2, R019.2.2, R020.2.2, R032).
5. Rollups restating the parent text, or duplicating another spec (R014.2, R017.2, R009.3).

## 7. Decisions needed (recommended option first)
1. Mirror sinks and Postgres replicas (R002.3, R023, R033): retire; nightly export only.
2. pgrx companion (R025): no-go ADR, drop the spike.
3. Attached-source live drivers: connectors own the call, medulla owns mapping and pushdown dialect.
4. Change capture for attached sources: only to refresh a bounded acceleration subset (R038); no full replication.
5. R038 row copy: keep as watermark-bound cache with a row cap (1,000,000) and TTL.
6. Authority vocabulary: SRC-AUTH owns; delete XSRC-R001.1/.2/.4.
7. SRC-AUTH-R800 concept ids: move to an ontology-ids spec; extend `concept_id.rs`.
8. Define or delete R094.
